text:
alex: Sales flagged tenant routing + enterprise SSO as a renewal blocker. They want it in v1.
maya: Define enterprise SSO here: OIDC, SCIM, audit streaming?
alex: Correct — OIDC + SCIM provisioning + audit log export to SIEM. They asked for early June.
simon: Our v1 public plan is mid-July. Early June is optimistic unless we cut scope.
emily: If we accelerate SSO work, we need to move something out. Least customer-facing: promo dashboard and extended analytics retention.
sam: SCIM is the biggest integration and test surface. OIDC + audit exports is considerably faster.
alfred: Customer said they'd accept an OIDC-first canary if we commit to SCIM GA by a firm date.
maya: Proposal: scoped canary — OIDC + audit export by Jun 15 (feature-flagged, 3 pilot tenants). SCIM GA as part of v1 on Jul 15. Cuts: promo dashboard and extended retention -> v1.1.
simon: Engineering estimate for scoped canary if prioritized: ~6w with two engineers diverted, infra and QA parallelized. SCIM moves to the v1 schedule.
emily: I'll draft the runbook and monitoring: auth success rate, latency, export backlog.
sam: Legal needs SLA review; that can add latency to commercial signoff. I'll loop counsel in.
alfred: I'll schedule weekly checkpoints with the customer. They want a firm SCIM GA date.
jira-bot: Created SSO-9999 "sso-scoped-canary"  https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SSO-9999
alex: Action items: maya -> PRD for canary by EOD; simon -> infra + routing plan by Fri; emily -> runbook + metrics by Fri; sam -> legal SLA kickoff; alfred -> customer checkpoints. I'll confirm canary acceptance criteria with customer today.
maya: ack :thumbsup:
simon: ack
emily: ack
Decision-summary: OIDC-canary targeted Jun 15 (feature-flagged, 3 pilots), SCIM GA targeted Jul 15 in v1. Cuts: promo dashboard and extended analytics retention -> v1.1. Risks: SLA negotiation and SCIM test coverage.
